title: A beach, from dawn to night
checked: Every reachable state checked (8 states, 20 with their data, 33 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 8 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: Nobody swims under a red flag
rules.says: Once the red flag is up, nobody goes back into the sea that day.
rules.path: Take away the green flag guard and it breaks in 5 steps: lifeguard on, next step, rip current, the rip eases, swim.

rules.rule: No sunbed is under the tide
rules.says: At high tide and through the night, every sunbed is stacked on the promenade.
rules.path: Take away the beds stacked guard and it breaks in 5 steps: lifeguard on, next step, next step, lifeguard off, high tide.
